name: ep2_prereg_v3
claim: At pre-committed checkpoint compression 0.44 (fixed 18.3% lead before snap), the differential recovery-time ratio (bistable/rigid) is elevated over baseline with single-test significance p<0.05 in >=4/5 seeds; no sequential scanning
null_model: checkpoint_null: rigid/rigid ratio at same checkpoint, single t-test, nominal FP 5%
refute_if: checkpoint detection in <4/5 seeds at 5% noise, OR null-arm (rigid/rigid) checkpoint false-positive rate > 10%, OR effect absent at 10% noise
